source_switch_policy.reason: avoid cascading Bitcoin-dependent restarts and preserve intentionally remote app configurations

security_invariants: bitcoin.conf stores rpcauth hashes rather than plaintext RPC passwords
managed Bitcoin RPC credentials are root-owned mode 0600
the Bitcoin data marker and bitcoin.conf are root-owned and group-readable only by the Bitcoin runtime group
RPC passwords do not enter broker command arguments, logs, API responses, or this evidence
local full-index apps fail closed on pruned, unsynchronized, or missing txindex state
all production endpoints and runtime manifests remain mainnet-only
